expected_behavior_change: On first upgraded SMT runtime start while online, clear the legacy SMT Admin config LKG/status once, preserving all order/payment/transaction runtime storage.
Every formal Admin publish receives a new canonical Cloud Hong Kong publish timestamp, regardless of diagnostic R/revision value or historical client timestamp.
Admin publish outbox is FIFO and removes only the exact Cloud-confirmed publish request; rapid publishes are not collapsed.
Cloud retains canonical publish history and SMT catch-up replays every publication after its last applied Hong Kong publish time.
Every ADMIN_CONFIG_AVAILABLE doorbell triggers the same canonical history catch-up; no R/revision comparison may veto a publish.
SMT ACK carries canonical publishedAt and is validated by fingerprint + publish time, not by current R/revision.
Admin and SMT human-facing sync status use Hong Kong publish/apply/readback time instead of Rxx as latest-state language.
Republishing historical content later is accepted as a new formal publish because Cloud assigns the new Hong Kong publish time.
non_goals: No Order, Pricing, Payment, Print, Keeta, Customer, SMM or Owner transaction authority change.
No destructive reset of transaction/order/payment data.
No Builder or OTA protocol redesign.
